Delete your Heads account

Deleting is permanent. It removes your sign-in account, profile, plans, commitments, check-ins, history, recurring series, blocks, account code, notification devices, preferences and receipts. Shared runs remain without your creator identity. Restricted safety reports remain after reporter/target identity links are removed: unresolved cases until resolution, then 90 days, with the original deadline preserved. Report text may contain supplied information. Anonymous usage events expire after 30 days. Backups/processor logs follow operator retention.

Sign in using an emailed code, then request a fresh deletion code and confirm within five minutes. No new account will be created.
